paragraphs: Ulla bar Menashya. He reported in the name of Avimi; Gittin 79a.[^1]

notes.text: עט.. is rendered 79a under the period convention, treating the doubled stop as folio-side punctuation and a terminal stop. No named edition is independently checked. Hyman gives only an attribution in Avimi’s name, not the statement’s content; no personal title is supplied.
